q: Is Joy Stream a real service?
a: No. It is a student project built to practise web design. The built-in titles are samples.
Create an account in the Sign In section. Your account, password (stored only as a salted hash) and uploads are saved inside this browser on this device, so they are not available on other devices.
Four titles play legal Blender Foundation open movies from YouTube. Every other built-in title has a short original placeholder trailer made for this project. Videos you upload play in full.

q: How do I add my own video and poster?
a: Sign in, open My Uploads and press Upload new. Choose a video file and a poster image from your device. No YouTube link is needed.

q: Can I edit or delete my uploads?
a: Yes. Open any title you uploaded and press Edit or Delete, or use the Edit button on its card. You can only change titles that belong to your account.
Press + My List on any title. The list is saved per account in this browser and stays after you refresh.
